summary.tldr: Creates an interim dental benefit for children under 12 and a one-time rental housing benefit, and makes related tax changes.
what_it_does: Creates an application-based interim dental benefit that gives direct financial support to parents for dental care for children under 12 from October 2022 to June 2024.
Creates a one-time rental housing benefit for eligible people who paid rent in 2022 for their principal residence and apply for the benefit.
Makes related amendments to the Income Tax Act, the Excise Tax Act, and the Excise Act, 2001.
